HORIZON_EULA.description: Type true to accept the Minecraft EULA (https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA); the server is created once you do

HORIZON_PLAYERS.description: Minecraft names allowed to join, separated by commas; the first one is the operator

HORIZON_RESOURCES_URL.description: Download link to a .zip or .tar.gz of the 26.3 folder your Horizon launcher prepared (see the README)

HORIZON_ONLINE.description: true checks Minecraft accounts (vanilla clients); false lets Horizon's own client join, read the README first

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time to save the world and stop the server cleanly on redeploy
